Markets.title: 10-year Treasury yield nears 5% ahead of Fed decision
Markets.summary: As the Federal Reserve meeting approaches, the 10-year Treasury yield is nearing 5% amid rising consumer prices, soaring oil costs, and a robust jobs report. Traders currently estimate an 89% probability of an interest rate hike this week.

Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq falls 1% at open on warnings about AI as Brent price jumps
Markets.summary: US stocks fell sharply on Monday, with the Nasdaq dropping 1.2% after AI industry leaders warned that development should slow for safety reasons. At the same time, Nvidia shares slid 3.8% and Brent crude jumped 3.8% to $108.74.

Markets.title: AI slowdown trade hits Nvidia, SoftBank, SK Hynix as global tech stocks fall up to 10%
Markets.summary: Global tech and AI-linked stocks fell up to 10%, with companies like Nvidia, SoftBank, and SK Hynix taking heavy hits. The sell-off was driven by growing safety concerns and calls from industry leaders to decelerate AI development, threatening the equity rally built on rapid growth expectations.

Markets.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: Nasdaq falls 1% at open on warnings about AI as Brent price jumps
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq fell one percent at the opening bell due to growing warnings about artificial intelligence. Meanwhile, Brent crude oil prices jumped significantly in today's trading session.

Markets.title: GIFT City Unlocked: What investors need to know about accessing global markets
Markets.summary: GIFT City is becoming a key gateway for Indian investors to access global markets through new financial products and fund structures. Industry experts will discuss these opportunities and the regulatory framework at the ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0 in Mumbai on October 8.

Markets.title: Quote of the day by David Swensen: "The underlying driving force behind market timing decisions seems to be emotional — fear, greed, chasing performance — buying something after it has gone up, disappointment, and sales after something has declined."
Markets.summary: David Swensen states that emotional biases like fear and greed drive poor market timing decisions. Investors should instead use disciplined, long-term strategies focused on controlling their reactions rather than predicting the market.

Geo-Political.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
Geo-Political.summary: China has criticized the Anthropic CEO's call to slow down global AI development, rejecting the idea that the two nations are in a malicious competition. The proposal was framed as an effort to prevent China from pulling ahead in the artificial intelligence race.

Geo-Political.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
Geo-Political.summary: Shortly after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other European officials departed a Ukrainian train station, Russian forces struck a stationary locomotive nearby on the Polish border. Johnson publicly condemned the attack, questioning the motives behind Russian President Vladimir Putin's decision to target the train.

Geo-Political.title: Thousands demand end to violence in Mexican cartel hotspot
Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of people protested in Culiacán to demand an end to the surge in violence. The conflict was triggered by a feud between two rival factions of the Sinaloa cartel.

Geo-Political.title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
Geo-Political.summary: With over 90% of ballots processed by early Monday, Sweden's left-wing bloc held a narrow lead of about 20,000 votes. The election remained too close to call as vote counting continued.

Geo-Political.title: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Africa in search of a mate
Geo-Political.summary: Three male wild dogs traveled 2,500 miles across Africa in search of a mate. Scientists state that this record-breaking journey demonstrates that wildlife can survive increasing environmental pressures.

Geo-Political.title: Malaysian boy acquitted for murder of schoolgirl on grounds of insanity
Geo-Political.summary: A Malaysian boy has been acquitted of murdering a 16-year-old schoolgirl after the court ruled he was insane at the time of the killing. The incident, which occurred nearly a year ago, shocked the nation and ignited discussions about the influence of social media.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation breaches RBl's midpoint target for third successive month
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to a 20-month high of 4.82% in August due to high food and fuel prices. This marks the third consecutive month that inflation has breached the Reserve Bank of India's midpoint target.

Data & Insights.title: Wholesale price inflation nears double digits in August; next month may be worse
Data & Insights.summary: India's wholesale price inflation approached double digits in August, and September's figures are expected to be even higher. Because businesses pass these rising input costs on to consumers, wholesale inflation drives up retail prices, which the Reserve Bank of India closely monitors alongside its official 2-6% retail target.

Data & Insights.title: Trump says US should have world’s lowest interest rates ahead of Fed meeting: ‘I know more about formulas’
Data & Insights.summary: Ahead of the Federal Reserve's September meeting, Donald Trump urged that the United States implement the world's lowest interest rates despite rising inflation and oil prices. Data & Insights.summary: Central banks in the US, UK, and Japan are holding key interest rate meetings this week. These decisions will shape the global economic and monetary policy outlook for the rest of 2026 and beyond.

Data & Insights.title: India’s 647 Rural Self Employment Training Institutes shift to digital platforms
